hero.title: Giving Day
hero.subhead: Giving Your Smile a Fresh Start
hero.line: Giving Day offers selected individuals who are not yet established patients at Central Dentist the opportunity to receive one complimentary dental treatment, consisting of either a cleaning, extraction, or filling.
hero.button: Reach Out For Your Chance To Be Accepted
hero.location: Central Dentist, 10210 N Central Expy, Ste 100, Dallas, TX 75231

intro: Giving Day is a special day at Central Dentist, dedicated to giving back to the community through complimentary dental care.
If you're new to our office and have been meaning to address a dental concern, this is an opportunity to have your needs cared for and learn more about your dental health.

faqs.a: Giving Day is Central Dentist's way of giving back to the community by welcoming new patients into the office for complimentary dental care. It's a one-day event, so appointment availability is limited.
Giving Day is for new patients. Existing Central Dentist patients aren't eligible for the Giving Day service.

items.text: One complimentary dental treatment, consisting of either a cleaning, extraction, or filling, as determined appropriate following the examination

faqs.q: How Do I Request an Appointment?
faqs.intro: To request consideration for Giving Day, please follow these steps:

items.label: Subject Line:
items.text: Giving Day / Your First and Last Name

items.label: Email Message:
items.text: Briefly describe your reason for requesting an appointment and your primary dental concerns.

faqs.outro: Our team will review the information submitted. If you are selected to participate, we will contact you by email with your scheduled appointment time.

faqs.a: Giving Day is our way of giving back to the holistic dental community through kindness, compassion, and radical generosity. By providing a complimentary dental service, we hope to help individuals take the first step toward better oral health while educating them about additional dental care that may benefit their overall well-being. We believe everyone deserves to feel heard, valued, and supported, and our goal is to make that first step a little easier.

finalCta.heading: Are You Ready to Give Your Smile a Fresh Start?
finalCta.body: Email us to be considered. Giving Day takes place Saturday, January 16, 2027, 8:00 AM–2:00 PM, at Central Dentist, 10210 N Central Expy, Ste 100, Dallas, TX 75231.
